title: AS 1926.1, swimming pool safety barriers
edition: AS 1926.1 (2012; a 2024 edition has since been published)
disclaimer: SAFETY CRITICAL, AND ONLY THE GEOMETRY IS CHECKED. AS 1926.1 is called up by every Australian state's building regulations, and a pool without a compliant barrier is an offence in all of them. What can be checked from a plan is the barrier's height, its offset and whether a non-climbable zone is kept clear. What CANNOT be checked from a plan, and is where inspections actually fail, is the gate: its self-closing and self-latching hardware, its swing, its latch height and the condition of its hinges. Confirm which edition your state has adopted -- a 2024 edition has been published and adoption is not uniform. Western Australia inspects barriers every four years for the life of the pool. Nothing here substitutes for that inspection.

rules.title: A pool has a barrier
rules.message: The pool has no barrier. Water deeper than 300 mm must be enclosed, spas and portable pools included.
rules.note: This is the provision drownings turn on. It is not waivable.

rules.title: Barrier height
rules.message: The barrier is {barrier_height_mm} mm; AS 1926.1 requires 1200 mm measured from finished ground level.
rules.note: Measured from the finished ground on the OUTSIDE of the barrier. Ground that is built up outside it reduces the effective height.

rules.title: Non-climbable zone
rules.message: The non-climbable zone is {non_climbable_zone_mm} mm; 900 mm is required outside the barrier.
rules.note: An arc, clear of anything a child can climb -- trees, pot plants, air-conditioning units, retaining walls, furniture. It has to stay clear after handover, which no drawing can enforce.

rules.title: Gap beneath the barrier
rules.message: The gap below the barrier is {barrier_gap_below_mm} mm; 100 mm is the maximum.

rules.title: Gate closes and latches itself
rules.message: Every gate must be self-closing and self-latching from any position, without manual force.
rules.note: Gates are the leading cause of inspection failure -- usually the hinge or the latch, years after the barrier passed.

rules.title: Gate swings away from the water
rules.message: Gates must be hung to swing outwards only, away from the pool.

rules.title: Room between the water and the barrier
rules.message: The barrier stands {barrier_offset_mm} mm from the water. A barrier hard against the coping leaves nowhere to stand.
rules.note: Not a standard requirement; a buildability check.
